inlineSql: Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL, B.GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.PR_CODE As PrCodeL,A.IT_TYPE As ItTypeL,A.TAG_TYPE As TagTypeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_NAME
Select * From DM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND DM_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.DM_NAME As ItemNameL,A.DM_CODE as ItCodeL,B.GR_NAME As GroupL FROM DM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.DM_NAME

SELECT GR_PR_RATE FROM RATE_MAST AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE = ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.IT_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT * FROM TOUCH_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_IT_CODE = ' ? '
INSERT INTO TOUCH_MAST (CO_CODE,LC_CODE,AC_CODE,AC_IT_CODE,AC_TOUCH,AC_WEST,AC_LBR_RATE) VALUES(' ? ' ,' ? ',' ? ', ' ? ' , ? ,0,0)
UPDATE TOUCH_MAST SET AC_TOUCH = ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_IT_CODE = ' ? '
UPDATE TOUCH_MAST SET AC_WEST = ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_IT_CODE = ' ? '
INSERT INTO TOUCH_MAST (CO_CODE,LC_CODE,AC_CODE,AC_IT_CODE,AC_TOUCH,AC_WEST,AC_LBR_RATE) VALUES(' ? ',' ? ',' ? ', ' ? ' ,0,0, ? )
UPDATE TOUCH_MAST SET AC_LBR_RATE = ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_IT_CODE = ' ? '
Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? ' ? A ? AND IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ?
Select IT_TOUCH,IT_WEST From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '
Select * From TOUCH_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_IT_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

Select IT_CODE,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) As GrWt, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) AS NetWt FROM MAIN_STOCK WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY IT_CODE
SELECT TOP(1) FINE_GL_RATE,FINE_SL_RATE,VCH_DATE FROM RATE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND SR_NO = 1 ORDER BY VCH_DATE DESC
Select Max(TAG_SRNO) AS SrNo FROM SRNO_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(TAG_SRNO) = 6 Having Max(TAG_SRNO) > 0
DELETE FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND SR_NO = ?
DELETE FROM MAIN_STOCK WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND SR_NO = ?
SELECT IT_DESIGN as DesignL From ITM_WT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY IT_DESIGN ORDER BY IT_DESIGN

SELECT A.DESIGN_NO as DesignL,BOOK_NAME As BookNameL,B.PR_NAME As ProductL,A.ITM_SIZE as SizeL,A.KR_NAME As KrNameL,A.ITM_TOUCH As TouchR,A.ITM_WEST_PRC AS WestPrcR,A.LBR_PRC AS LbrPrcR,A.LBR_RATE As LbrRateR,A.DESIGN_IMG_ID As DesignIdL FROM (DESIGN_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.PR_CODE = B.PR_CODE) LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.PR_CODE = C.PR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.IT_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.BOOK_NAME,A.DESIGN_NO,A.SR_NO
SELECT AC_NAME As KarigarL,AC_SHORT as CodeL FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_SHORT <> '' ORDER BY AC_NAME

SELECT A.ISU_AC_NAME as CustNameL,A.ISU_NO As VchNoL,A.DESIGN_NO As DesignL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.ITM_REMARK AS OrderDesc,A.ITM_SIZE as SizeL,A.ISU_SRNO AS SrNoM,A.ISU_YRCD As YearL,A.ISU_DBCD As BookL,A.ISU_AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME As KrgrL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.AC_SHORT As AcShortL,A.ISU_LC_CODE As OrdLcM FROM (APR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = '051' AND A.ISU_REC = 'N' AND A.ISU_NO <> '' ORDER BY A.VCH_NO,A.SR_NO
SELECT LBR_RATE,LBR_AMT,DESIGN_NO From BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND DESIGN_NO = ' ? ' ORDER BY VCH_DATE DESC
SELECT DISTINCT DESIGN_NO as DesignL From BAR_DETL ORDER BY DESIGN_NO
SELECT * FROM TAG_IMAGE_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND IMAGE_TYPE = 'D'
Select * From EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND EMP_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT EMP_NAME As EmpNameL,EMP_CODE as CodeL FROM EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY EMP_CODE
Select * From TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' and LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TABLE_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT TABLE_NAME As CounterL,TABLE_CODE as CodeL FROM TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
SELECT * FROM ITM_WT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND IT_DESIGN = 'N' ? AND IT_DESIGN = ' ? ' ? AND FROM_WT <= ? AND TO_WT >= ?
SELECT * FROM ITM_WT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? ' AND FROM_WT <= ? AND TO_WT >= ?
Select * From LBR_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LBR_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT LBR_CODE As LbrCodeL,LBR_CATG as CategoryL,LBR_VAL As LbrValueR FROM LBR_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY LBR_CATG,LBR_CODE
SELECT MODEL_NAME From MODEL_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND MODEL_NAME = ' ? '
SELECT DISTINCT MODEL_NAME as StyleL From MODEL_MAST ORDER BY MODEL_NAME
INSERT INTO TAG_SET(CO_CODE,LC_CODE,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,TAG_NO,VCH_SRNO,TAG_TYPE,PR_CODE) VALUES (' ? ',' ? ',' ? ',' ? ',' ? ',' ? ',' ? ',' ? ')
DELETE FROM TAG_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = 'OLD'
DELETE FROM TAG_SET WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = 'OLD'

INSERT INTO TAG_SET(CO_CODE,LC_CODE,TAG_TYPE,PR_CODE,VCH_SRNO,TAG_NO,CO_BOOK) Select CO_CODE,LC_CODE,TAG_TYPE,PR_CODE,0,TAG_NO,'OLD' FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO <> 'N' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO IN(SELECT TAG_NO From MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND B.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE <> '' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) = 7 AND A.CO_BOOK NOT IN ('018','019') GROUP BY A.TAG_NO HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0) GROUP BY CO_CODE,LC_CODE,TAG_TYPE,PR_CODE,TAG_NO UNION ALL SELECT ' ? ',' ? ',TAG_TYPE,PR_CODE,0,TAG_NO, ? Y ? 'OLD' ? ' ? ' ? FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? '

INSERT INTO TAG_SET(CO_CODE,LC_CODE,TAG_TYPE,PR_CODE,VCH_SRNO,TAG_NO,CO_BOOK) Select ' ? ',' ? ',TAG_TYPE,PR_CODE,0,TAG_NO,'OLD' FROM BAR_DETL WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO <> 'N' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO IN(SELECT TAG_NO From MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE B.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND B.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE <> '' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) = 8 AND A.CO_BOOK NOT IN ('018','019') GROUP BY A.TAG_NO HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0) GROUP BY LC_CODE,TAG_TYPE,PR_CODE,TAG_NO UNION ALL SELECT ' ? ',' ? ',TAG_TYPE,PR_CODE,0,TAG_NO, ? Y ? 'OLD' ? ' ? ' ? FROM BAR_DETL WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? '
SELECT TAG_NO,SUBSTRING(TAG_NO,4,4) AS SrNo FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO <> '' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY TAG_SRNO DESC
SELECT TAG_NO FROM TAG_SET WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(TAG_NO) = 7 GROUP BY TAG_NO ORDER BY TAG_NO
SELECT TAG_NO,SUBSTRING(TAG_NO,4,5) AS SrNo FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO <> '' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY TAG_SRNO DESC
SELECT TAG_NO FROM TAG_SET WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(TAG_NO) = 8 GROUP BY TAG_NO ORDER BY TAG_NO

SELECT RIGHT(A.LOT_NO,5) AS TAG_SRNO FROM LOT_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(A.LOT_NO) > 4 AND TRY_CAST(RIGHT(A.LOT_NO,5) AS INT) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY RIGHT(A.LOT_NO,5) ORDER BY RIGHT(A.LOT_NO,5) DESC

SELECT RIGHT(A.LOT_NO,4) AS TAG_SRNO FROM ITM_LOT_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND SUBSTRING(LOT_NO,5,1) = ' ? ' GROUP BY RIGHT(A.LOT_NO,4) ORDER BY RIGHT(A.LOT_NO,4) DESC

SELECT TOP 1 TAG_SRNO FROM (SELECT CAST(TAG_SRNO AS INT) AS TAG_SRNO FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND LEN(TAG_NO) > 6 AND LEN(TAG_NO) <=9 GROUP BY TAG_SRNO UNION ALL SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(A.TAG_NO,4,LEN(A.TAG_NO)) AS INT)) AS TAG_SRNO FROM SRNO_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) > 6 AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) < =9 AND B.TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' ) AS X GROUP BY TAG_SRNO ORDER BY TAG_SRNO DESC

Select SUBSTRING(A.TAG_NO,4,LEN(A.TAG_NO)) As TAG_SRNO FROM SRNO_MAST As A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST As B On A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) > 6 AND B.TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(A.TAG_NO,4,LEN(A.TAG_NO)) ORDER BY SUBSTRING(A.TAG_NO,4,LEN(A.TAG_NO)) DESC
SELECT TOP 2 TAG_SRNO FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' GROUP BY TAG_SRNO ORDER BY TAG_SRNO DESC
